title: Peninsula Energy Lance uranium project cyber incident, Nov 2026

subject.name: Peninsula Energy
subject.about: Peninsula Energy is a uranium company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange. It is building a US uranium production business at its Lance and Dagger projects in Wyoming, where Lance recovers uranium underground by in-situ recovery and has its own processing plant.

also_called: the Lance uranium project cyber incident
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Peninsula Energy, Strata Energy, any government agency, news outlet, company, group, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One uranium recovery operation in northeast Wyoming, shut down while the company checks its control systems. Peninsula says its corporate systems were not affected, and nothing public shows any effect beyond the site and the company's shares.
who_is_affected: The Lance uranium operation in Crook County, Wyoming, which has stopped working, and Peninsula Energy's shareholders, whose shares cannot be traded until Nov 30 at the latest. The company has not said whether anyone's data was affected. Nothing it has said affects the public directly.

known.text: Peninsula Energy says a cybersecurity incident hit the plant and wellfield control systems at its Lance uranium project on Nov 20.
Operations at Lance are suspended until the company's recovery and safety checks are finished. No restart date has been given.
The company says its corporate systems, including payroll and finance, were not affected.
It says it has told the relevant US authorities and hired outside cyber security, forensic and legal advisers.

not_known.text: Who or what caused the incident, and how it happened.
Whether any data was taken. The company is still checking.
When the Lance operation will restart.

figures.label: Shares suspended until, at the latest
figures.detail: Or until a restart is announced
